title: Candidate supply and answer selection shape the value of LLM judging in multi-agent systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.25937v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) sometimes already have the potential to answer correctly, but still report a wrong answer. Explaining this outcome is difficult because generation, communication and final answer-selection rules usually change simultaneously. We conceptualize multi-agent reasoning as an evolutionary pipeline of candidate generation, peer communication and terminal selection, wherein consensus without quality control can exhibit patterns of memetic drift. We study two questions: (1) when an LLM judge provides effective selection pressure by supplying a signal of answer correctness for candidates generated in a multi-agent system, and (2) when using that signal improves the reported answer. To map judge reliability, we analysed 15,336 questions from MMLU-Pro, GPQA, MedXpertQA and MuSR, with Humanity's Last Exam analysed separately. translated_title: 候选供给与答案选择如何塑造LLM评判在多智能体系统中的价值
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统有时已经具备正确回答的潜力，但最终仍报告了错误答案。解释这一现象很困难，因为生成、通信和最终答案选择规则通常会同时发生变化。我们将多智能体推理概念化为一个由候选生成、同伴通信和终端选择组成的演化流水线，其中缺乏质量控制的一致性共识可能表现出模因漂移的模式。我们研究了两个问题：（1）LLM评判器何时能通过为多智能体系统生成的候选答案提供正确性信号来施加有效的选择压力；（2）何时使用该信号能够改善最终报告的答案。为了刻画评判器的可靠性，我们分析了来自MMLU-Pro、GPQA、MedXpertQA和MuSR的15,336个问题，并对Humanity's Last Exam进行了单独分析。为了测试这些规则，我们重放了从16,278个问题中抽取的81,390个固定候选池……
tldr: 该论文将多智能体推理建模为“候选生成—同伴通信—终端选择”的演化流水线，系统揭示了LLM评判器何时能提供有效的答案正确性选择压力、以及何时使用该信号能真正改善多智能体系统的最终答案。
en_tdlr: This paper conceptualizes multi-agent reasoning as an evolutionary pipeline of candidate generation, peer communication, and terminal selection, systematically revealing when LLM judges provide effective selection pressure for answer correctness and when using that signal actually improves the final reported answer of multi-agent systems.
